correctness.rationale: For an equivalence cell of size at most two, Δ marks exactly cells whose valuation is constant. Singleton input and crossing-edge boundaries force overlapping distinct colored matching edges to close as alternating 4-cycles; otherwise components are isolated singleton or dyad. Conversely, alternating squares commute because both operator compositions test the XOR parity a⊕b⊕c⊕d, and dyads are readily checked by their constant-cell flags. Involutions commute exactly on these components. The exponential component census is exp(z+3z²/2+z⁴/4), independently enumerated for n=0..5: 1,1,4,10,52,196. Minor proof wording caveat: on a singleton-cell dyad Δ does not act as the identity on raw valuation subsets; it sends them to the full dyad. The dyad commutation conclusion is nonetheless correct by direct checking.
